title: selbya montana
intro: Selbya montana, commonly known as the "Kutu" or "Katu" plant, is a species of flowering plant native to the tropical forests of Sri Lanka. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for centuries due to its numerous health benefits, which include its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Selbya montana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which exhibit antioxidant, antiviral, and antifungal activities. Additionally, Selbya montana has been found to possess immunomodulatory and anti-cancer properties, making it a valuable resource in the search for new medicinal compounds.
